_note: Single source for the OIDC redirect URI (flutter-login-and-app-shell task 3.3): Gradle reads this file for the Android deep-link manifestPlaceholder AND CI passes it via --dart-define-from-file (an explicit --dart-define wins, but bootstrap fail-closes on any mismatch — see checkRedirectConsistency). This file is also bundled as an app asset for that check. Dev default below; production uses its IdP-registered URI. The scheme is derived PER FLAVOR (issue #419, option 2b): prod registers this URI verbatim, the dev flavor appends `-dev` to a custom scheme (`breakdown://` → `breakdown-dev://`) so a co-installed prod app never competes for the redirect — the dev IdP client registration must allowlist the derived URI too.
